activity.notes: Woqini, commonly rendered Roman Nose or Hook Nose, was a Northern Cheyenne warrior and war leader, not a civil chief of the Cheyenne nation. He led war parties during the Plains conflicts and was killed at Beecher Island on 17 September 1868.
